Thanks Ava  quick answers below inline.

On Fri, Jul 17, 2026 at 9:45 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Primary use cases you want to optimize in the POC (chat latency, summarization accuracy, embeddings for search, etc.)?

We care about two things initially: (1) chat latency for our patient-facing triage chatbot (typical turns ~40-120 tokens), and (2) nightly batch summarization of patient interactions (avg summary length ~800 tokens).

> - Typical request patterns: are you mostly short chat turns (<128 tokens) or longer summaries (500-2,000 tokens)?

As above: chat mostly short; summaries longer (500-1,200 tokens).

> - SLA/Compliance: you mentioned SOC 2  do you need a dedicated/private deployment or will hosted (with contractual controls) work for the POC?

For POC, hosted with contractual SOC 2 attestation is fine. If the POC goes to production, we9ll likely need a private VPC deployment and a KMS integration.

> - Current infra: which model families and runtimes are you using today (open-source model name / size, or managed API)?

We use a mix: some customer-facing flows on a tuned Llama2-13B (quantized) serving on-prem, and some research/experiments on Mistral-family models via managed API.

> - Success criteria & timeline: what does a successful POC look like (latency targets, cost delta, throughput)?

Success = <150ms 95th percentile on typical chat paths, ~30% reduction in per-token cost vs our current managed API baseline, and ability to handle 200 concurrent chat users during peak. Timeline: start POC early August, 4-week POC.

Availability: Tomorrow (Sat) is tough  we prefer Mon 19 Jul 11:00-11:30am PT or Tue 20 Jul 2:00-2:30pm PT. Elena (cc9d) will own coordination on our side.

Thanks,
Sam
Director, Data & AI
CareWell Health
